items.claim: Commercial-design-win momentum is broadening faster than disclosed scaled production economics are becoming visible.

finding: The newest primary-customer/OEM evidence clarifies that Aeva's disclosed Daimler/Torc role is long-range LiDAR while Innoviz is separately selected for short-range LiDAR. It does not disclose committed Aeva production volumes, unit economics, gross-margin economics, or scaled recurring production economics, so it does not resolve the Resolver-owned contradiction.
reason: The input changed, but the new evidence is architecture/supplier-scope evidence rather than production-economics evidence. Preserve the material contradiction without weakening the gate until genuinely new source-addressed scaled-production economics appear.
authorityBoundary: No canonical methodology, score, rank, tick, membership, Beast/integrity gate, or Earth Core decision is modified.
